blocks.title: Vendor Assessment and Selection exam shortcuts
items: Need to evaluate a vendor before approval → DUE DILIGENCE
Investigate the vendor before entering the relationship.
Example: Review financial health, security posture, and compliance history.
Customer wants contractual ability to inspect controls → RIGHT-TO-AUDIT
Put audit rights directly into the agreement.
Example: Contract allows annual customer security audits.
Vendor gives its own audit report → INTERNAL AUDIT EVIDENCE
The evidence comes from the vendor's internal review function.
Example: Vendor provides internal control-audit results.
Need stronger independent assurance → INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT
Use an outside assessor rather than relying only on vendor claims.
Vendor depends on another supplier → SUPPLY CHAIN ANALYSIS
Third-party risk can extend to fourth parties and dependencies.
Example: Your SaaS provider relies on another cloud provider.
Person selecting vendor has personal financial interest → CONFLICT OF INTEREST
The decision may not be impartial.
Example: Procurement manager owns stock in one bidder.
blocks.example: First identify the vendor-lifecycle stage: assessment/selection, agreement/contracting, or ongoing monitoring.

questions.q: A company reviews a prospective vendor's security posture, financial stability, compliance history, and references before signing a contract. Which process is this?
questions.explanation: Due diligence evaluates a prospective vendor before selection.

questions.q: A contract gives the customer permission to inspect the vendor's security controls each year. Which clause is this?
questions.explanation: A right-to-audit clause allows the customer to audit or assess vendor controls.

questions.q: A vendor provides a SOC 2 report completed by an external auditor. What type of evidence is this?
questions.explanation: A SOC 2 report from an outside assessor is an independent assessment.

questions.q: A vendor provides documentation from its own internal audit department. What type of evidence is this?
questions.explanation: The evidence was produced by the vendor's internal audit function.

questions.q: A SaaS provider relies on another cloud provider that also handles customer data. Which process should evaluate this additional dependency?
questions.explanation: Supply chain analysis evaluates vendor dependencies and fourth-party risk.

questions.q: A procurement manager owns a financial interest in one of the companies bidding for a contract. What issue is this?
questions.explanation: A conflict of interest may improperly influence vendor selection.

questions.q: An authorized security team actively attempts to exploit weaknesses in a vendor-hosted application. Which assessment method is this?
questions.explanation: Penetration testing actively attempts exploitation to evaluate security.
